$comment: Cohort manifest for the public-AUT cold-start cohort. Authoritative for which AUTs sit on which side of the clean-room partition (see docs/v2-cold-start-cohort-spike.md §4.4). The trust-policy gate must consult this manifest at runtime to refuse canon graduation in held-out contexts (C2). Promotion held-out → training is allowed and irreversible (C4); training → held-out is forbidden.

auts.name: todomvc
auts.notes: React variant. Has notable real-world ARIA imperfections (anonymous destroy buttons with no accessible name, per-todo <label> with no for attribute, no aria-current on selected filter, no explicit landmark roles). Surface inventory captured in docs/v2-cold-start-todomvc-journal.md Entry 3.

auts.name: httpbin-form
auts.promotionReason: Cycles 5-7 used httpbin failures (Probe Seeds 10, 11) to drive classifier code changes. The held-out partition is contaminated; promoting to training per spike §4.4 C4 (one-way promotion held-out -> training is allowed and irreversible). See journal Entry 32.
auts.notes: Pizza-order form demo at httpbin.org. Different shape from TodoMVC training (server-rendered HTML, wrapping <label> elements with no for attribute, inputs with name but no id/aria-label). First introduced as held-out in cycle 5; promoted to training in cycle 8 after acknowledging that operator inspection during cycles 6-7 fed observe-side classifier improvements.

auts.name: outsystems-com
auts.promotionReason: Cycle 9's clean held-out evaluation (journal Entry 36) scored 0/3 on DOM-targeting steps. Cycle 10 uses those three failures to drive the degraded-resolution ladder (phrase reduction + inventory harvest + evidence-carrying handoffs), so per spike §4.4 C4 the AUT promotes held-out -> training (one-way, irreversible) before any cycle-10 code change lands. A fresh held-out is designated for cycle 11.
auts.notes: OutSystems corporate marketing homepage. Authored as the cycle-9 fresh held-out following the cycle-8 cleanup. Operator inspection confirmed the site is NOT built on OutSystems Reactive (no osui-* classes, no __OSVSTATE) — it's a marketing site, not a Reactive demo app. The cycle-9 handoff evaluation (journal Entry 36) scored 0/3 on DOM-targeting steps; cycle 10 used those failures to build the degraded-resolution ladder, so the AUT promoted to training. Fixtures are at revision 2: the cycle-10 handoff evidence revealed the locale links sit behind a collapsed 'EN' navbar dropdown with a cookie banner in front, so the fixtures gained preconditions per the cycle-7 precedent.

auts.name: saucedemo
auts.notes: Swag Labs (Sauce Labs' QA demo) login page. Authored as the cycle-11 fresh held-out after cycle 10 consumed outsystems-com. Shape-differentiated from all training AUTs: a credential form (two labeled textboxes + one button) rather than a todo list or marketing page. The authoring agent made exactly ONE inspection pass (an aria snapshot of the login page) to author expectedTarget values, per spike §4.4 C5, and never ran the cohort runner against it. EVALUATION HANDED OFF — see docs/v2-cold-start-cohort-handoff-cycle-11.md. The agent that built cycle 10's ladder MUST NOT run the evaluation; a fresh agent runs it once and reports back. Best suited to a pure-structural eval (the form fields resolve without reasoning); left pending for a truly fresh session.

auts.name: the-internet
auts.evaluationResult: 91401 (tickbox->Checkboxes): resolved at rung 'reasoning', expected-match verified — the fill was authored by a context-isolated subagent (fresh evaluator, 24757 tokens) blind to the expectedTarget, and its independent bridge matched the authored ground truth. A clean generalization datapoint for the reasoning rung. 91402 (picklist->Dropdown): wrong-target false positive — the phrase-reduction rung reduced 'picklist control' to 'control' and matched 'Dynamic Controls' (the only /control/i link), never reaching reasoning. A real precision bug the held-out caught (synthesis G6 never modeled a reduction matching an UNINTENDED element). Journal Entry 40. Per §4.4 C4, this AUT promotes held-out -> training when the phrase-reduction-overreach fix that 91402 drives lands; until then it is evaluated-but-not-yet-consumed.
auts.notes: the-internet (Sauce Labs' QA-automation playground) — purpose-built for testing and never redesigned, so it is a stable held-out. Designated cycle 11 to test the Z11d reasoning rung's GENERALIZATION: the two fixtures (91401-91402) are zero-token-overlap SYNONYM bridges against the 45-link landing menu — 'tickbox example' → Checkboxes, 'picklist control' → Dropdown — that the structured/strict/phrase-reduction rungs all correctly miss, so only the reasoning rung can resolve them. The reasoning fill is authored by a CONTEXT-ISOLATED subagent (fresh evaluator) blind to the authored expectedTarget; the test is whether the independent reasoner's bridge matches the authored ground truth. ONE authoring inspection (the 45-link census) was made to write expectedTargets per §4.4 C5. Honest clean-room caveat: the building agent authored the fixtures and orchestrates the subagent; a context-isolated subagent is the in-session approximation of a fresh evaluator, weaker than a human-relayed separate session (journal Entry 40).
